sourceAttempts.result: IEEE DOI pages, CVF/ECVA proceedings, NeurIPS proceedings, PMLR, and SAGE DOI records supplied formal metadata and method claims.
Used for papers or datasets whose formal page was unavailable or whose 2026 record was still a preprint; official author/project links were cross-checked when present.
Used to verify dataset scale, synchronization/calibration protocol, release state, and code/data destinations.
Pinned commits or revisions for OpenCOOD, FreeAlign, V2I-Calib, DAIR-V2X, V2X-Real, CooperScene, and the CooperScene Hugging Face model release; inspected schemas and functions.

Read legacy closure v8, the cooperative autonomous driving review, citation audits, asset audits, and CooperScene mini-release audit. Local audits were used as provenance pointers and were rechecked against their named primary sources where this decision depends on them.

searchAudit.searchConclusion: The search found many alignment, calibration, and robustness methods, but no public 2023-2026 real or semi-real benchmark that jointly and independently labels clock offset or transport latency, navigation pose error, and online extrinsic drift at the item/message level. It also found no existing fixed-fuser evaluation with labels for association failure and harmful fusion that can validate the requested interaction posterior.

verifiedReferences.title: FreeAlign: Object-Level Feature Alignment for Disturbance-Resistant Collaborative Perception
verifiedReferences.factsVerified: Object-level graph matching and point-set alignment recover relative pose and temporal correspondence under disturbances.
verifiedReferences.limitationForCandidate: Produces an alignment transform/correspondence, not a calibrated clock-pose-extrinsic joint posterior, and does not expose independent truth for all three states.

verifiedReferences.title: TraF-Align: Trajectory-aware Feature Alignment for Asynchronous Multi-agent Perception
verifiedReferences.factsVerified: Uses trajectories to align asynchronous collaborative features and evaluates on V2V4Real and DAIR-V2X-Seq.
verifiedReferences.limitationForCandidate: No item-level decomposition into clock, navigation pose, and extrinsic drift and no calibrated multivariate posterior.

verifiedReferences.title: CoST: Efficient Collaborative Perception From Unified Spatiotemporal Perspective
verifiedReferences.factsVerified: Unifies spatial and temporal feature processing for efficient collaborative perception.
verifiedReferences.limitationForCandidate: A unified representation is not evidence of an identifiable joint latent-error posterior.

verifiedReferences.title: CATNet: Collaborative Alignment and Transformation Network for Cooperative Perception
verifiedReferences.factsVerified: Combines spatiotemporal synchronization, denoising, and collaborative transformation/selection.
verifiedReferences.limitationForCandidate: Does not supply separable error-state truth or posterior calibration; composing similar modules is already occupied design space.

verifiedReferences.title: CoBEVFlow: Flow-based Bird's Eye View Feature Fusion for Cooperative Perception
verifiedReferences.factsVerified: Uses BEV flow to compensate irregular time delay and reports simulated and DAIR-V2X experiments.
verifiedReferences.limitationForCandidate: The compensation is deterministic/learned alignment; injected asynchrony is not a natural clock or latency occurrence label.

verifiedReferences.title: Latency Robust Cooperative Perception using Asynchronous Feature Fusion
verifiedReferences.factsVerified: Uses cached asynchronous features and motion compensation for latency robustness.
verifiedReferences.limitationForCandidate: Does not identify or calibrate a joint physical error posterior.

verifiedReferences.title: Multi-agent Collaborative Perception via Motion-aware Robust Communication Network
verifiedReferences.factsVerified: Targets pose error and motion-induced feature degradation through robust communication.
verifiedReferences.limitationForCandidate: Robustness to perturbation is not state identification and supplies no clock/extrinsic truth decomposition.

verifiedReferences.title: Robust Collaborative 3D Object Detection in Presence of Pose Errors
verifiedReferences.factsVerified: CoAlign performs pose-error-robust collaborative detection and serves as a strong pose-only baseline.
verifiedReferences.limitationForCandidate: No clock or extrinsic posterior; pose correction can absorb other spatial errors.

verifiedReferences.title: CoBEVGlue: Feature Alignment with Sparse Context and Geometry
verifiedReferences.factsVerified: Estimates relative alignment from sparse collaborative geometric context.
verifiedReferences.limitationForCandidate: Returns alignment rather than a calibrated, separately grounded joint error posterior.

verifiedReferences.title: Align Before Collaborate: Mitigating Feature Misalignment for Robust Collaborative Perception
verifiedReferences.factsVerified: NEAT addresses feature misalignment caused by pose and delay before fusion.
verifiedReferences.limitationForCandidate: Does not establish separate physical-state truth or multivariate posterior calibration.

verifiedReferences.title: A Robust Spatial Calibration Method for Cooperative Perception
verifiedReferences.factsVerified: Uses object associations to estimate a relative spatial calibration transform.
verifiedReferences.limitationForCandidate: A point transform cannot separate navigation pose error from sensor extrinsic error without an external anchor.

verifiedReferences.title: V2I-Calib: A Novel Calibration Approach for Collaborative Vehicle and Infrastructure LiDARs
verifiedReferences.factsVerified: Estimates vehicle-infrastructure LiDAR registration from associated 3D objects and publishes official code/data indices.
verifiedReferences.limitationForCandidate: Targets an extrinsic/registration point estimate only; official metadata does not contain clock truth or a separate navigation-pose-error label.

verifiedReferences.title: V2X-Reg++: An Object-Level Approach for Real-Time Collaborative Multi-Agent Perception
verifiedReferences.factsVerified: Extends object-level online registration for real-time collaborative agents.
verifiedReferences.limitationForCandidate: Still estimates a composite spatial registration and does not identify clock, body pose, and sensor extrinsic separately.

verifiedReferences.title: MamV2XCalib: V2X-based Target-less Infrastructure Camera Calibration with State Space Model
verifiedReferences.factsVerified: Uses vehicle LiDAR and a state-space model for targetless infrastructure-camera calibration on V2X datasets.
verifiedReferences.limitationForCandidate: A state-space model is not the requested joint posterior and does not add independent clock and navigation-pose truth.

verifiedReferences.title: Joint Spatial-Temporal Calibration for Camera and Global Pose Sensor
verifiedReferences.factsVerified: Jointly calibrates spatial and temporal offsets and explicitly analyzes observability with a global pose sensor and informative motion.
verifiedReferences.limitationForCandidate: It demonstrates that extra pose anchors and excitation are required; ordinary collaborative detections do not provide those anchors.

verifiedReferences.title: SOAC: Spatio-Temporal Overlap-Aware Multi-Sensor Calibration using Neural Radiance Fields
verifiedReferences.factsVerified: Performs targetless spatial-temporal calibration using scene overlap and a reference sensor.
verifiedReferences.limitationForCandidate: Requires a calibration-specific reference and scene model; it does not validate a V2X error posterior on fixed fusion datasets.

verifiedReferences.title: Multi-sensor calibration for mobile robots using the single-plane constraint
verifiedReferences.factsVerified: Studies calibration constraints and degeneracies for mobile multisensor systems.
verifiedReferences.limitationForCandidate: Supports the need for explicit observability constraints; it is not evidence that cooperative feature residuals identify all requested states.

verifiedReferences.title: Evaluating Posterior Probabilities: Decision Theory, Proper Scoring Rules, and Calibration
verifiedReferences.factsVerified: Explains why proper scoring rules evaluate posterior probabilities and why calibration diagnostics alone are incomplete.
verifiedReferences.limitationForCandidate: Provides evaluation methodology, not labels or identifiability for cooperative-perception error states.

verifiedReferences.title: Proper Scoring Rules for Multivariate Probabilistic Forecasts based on Aggregation and Transformation
verifiedReferences.factsVerified: Defines multivariate proper-scoring constructions suited to dependence-sensitive posterior comparison.
verifiedReferences.limitationForCandidate: Cannot make a joint posterior identifiable when the state variables are not separately observed.

verifiedReferences.title: On the Estimation of Calibration Errors in Probabilistic Classification
verifiedReferences.factsVerified: Analyzes calibration-error estimation and finite-sample pitfalls.
verifiedReferences.limitationForCandidate: Does not replace item-level truth and warns against declaring calibration from a single estimated metric.

verifiedReferences.title: Spatiotemporal Feature Alignment and Weighted Fusion for Robust Cooperative Perception under Communication Delays
verifiedReferences.factsVerified: Models clock drift, link delay, age-of-information, feature alignment, and uncertainty weighting in a simulation-oriented setting.
verifiedReferences.limitationForCandidate: Simulated impairment injection does not establish natural occurrence rates or independent real clock/pose/extrinsic truth.

verifiedReferences.title: STCC: Spatio-Temporal Collaborative Perception for Connected and Autonomous Driving
verifiedReferences.factsVerified: Combines temporal compensation and uncertainty-aware collaboration for delayed V2X perception.
verifiedReferences.limitationForCandidate: Uncertainty over predictions or features is not an identifiable posterior over clock, pose, and extrinsic states.

verifiedReferences.title: V2X-Seq: A Large-Scale Sequential Dataset for Vehicle-Infrastructure Cooperative Perception and Forecasting
verifiedReferences.factsVerified: Provides sequential vehicle-infrastructure perception and forecasting data derived from DAIR-V2X infrastructure.
verifiedReferences.limitationForCandidate: Sequences, timestamps, poses, and nominal calibration are not independent truth for clock offset, transport latency, navigation-pose error, and extrinsic drift.

verifiedReferences.title: V2V4Real: A Real-World Large-Scale Dataset for Vehicle-to-Vehicle Cooperative Perception
verifiedReferences.factsVerified: Provides real two-vehicle collaborative sensor data with localization and calibration products.
verifiedReferences.limitationForCandidate: Does not publish per-message source-clock/transport-delay truth or independently measured pose-error and extrinsic-drift trajectories.

verifiedReferences.title: V2X-Real: a Largs-Scale Dataset for Vehicle-to-Everything Cooperative Perception
verifiedReferences.factsVerified: Provides real multi-agent V2X collaborative perception data and official code/data release paths.
verifiedReferences.limitationForCandidate: Published data are synchronized/calibrated observations, not independent labelled trajectories for the three error causes; official checkpoint availability is incomplete.

verifiedReferences.title: V2X-ReaLO: An Open Online Framework and Dataset for Cooperative Perception
verifiedReferences.factsVerified: Reports an online ROS-bag-based cooperative dataset and communication-latency evaluation with 25,028 test frames and 6,850 key frames.
verifiedReferences.limitationForCandidate: Observed end-to-end latency does not separate source clock offset from transport delay, and the paper does not document independent pose-error and extrinsic-drift truth; the promised release was not confirmed as a pinned runnable asset.

verifiedReferences.title: CooperScene: A Comprehensive Real-World Collaborative Perception Dataset
verifiedReferences.factsVerified: Publishes real collaborative data, communication traces, PTP/hardware synchronization, and GNSS-RTK plus spatial-temporal ICP calibration, with official code/data/checkpoints.
verifiedReferences.limitationForCandidate: Those procedures create nominally synchronized/calibrated data; they do not label residual clock offset, navigation pose error, and extrinsic drift independently per message.

verifiedReferences.title: CoopScenes: A Multi-Sensor Dataset for Cooperative Perception
verifiedReferences.factsVerified: Uses PTP/GNSS-based synchronization and tailored calibration and reports a mean synchronization deviation around 2.3 ms.
verifiedReferences.limitationForCandidate: A residual synchronization statistic is not per-sample clock/latency truth, and pose-versus-extrinsic errors remain inseparable.

verifiedReferences.title: UrbanV2X: A Large-Scale Multi-Sensor Dataset for Cooperative Perception
verifiedReferences.factsVerified: Reports PTP synchronization, GNSS-RTK/INS, UWB, and multi-sensor calibration in urban V2X collection.
verifiedReferences.limitationForCandidate: The additional sensors are promising anchors, but the public description does not expose independently labelled clock, navigation-pose-error, and extrinsic-drift trajectories.

verifiedReferences.title: TUMTraf V2X Cooperative Perception Dataset
verifiedReferences.factsVerified: Provides real infrastructure-vehicle sensor data with localization/calibration products and diverse traffic scenes.
verifiedReferences.limitationForCandidate: Nominal GPS/IMU poses and calibration files do not expose the errors of those estimates as separate time series.

verifiedReferences.title: Multi-V2X: A Large Scale Multi-modal Multi-penetration-rate Dataset for Cooperative Perception
verifiedReferences.factsVerified: Uses SUMO and CARLA to construct a controllable large-scale cooperative simulation dataset.
verifiedReferences.limitationForCandidate: Simulation can provide separable state truth, but injected distributions cannot be reported as natural error occurrence or real posterior calibration.

verifiedReferences.title: UrbanIng-V2X: A Multi-Level Cooperative Perception Dataset
verifiedReferences.factsVerified: Provides real multi-level V2X data described as temporally aligned and spatially calibrated.
verifiedReferences.limitationForCandidate: Alignment/calibration outputs are nominal inputs, not separate truth for their residual errors or drift.

verifiedReferences.title: SyncNet: Latency-Aware Collaborative Perception
verifiedReferences.factsVerified: A foundational latency-aware collaborative perception baseline using temporal prediction/alignment.
verifiedReferences.limitationForCandidate: Outside the core year window and does not infer a calibrated three-state posterior.

verifiedReferences.title: DAIR-V2X: A Large-Scale Dataset for Vehicle-Infrastructure Cooperative 3D Object Detection
verifiedReferences.factsVerified: Provides real vehicle-infrastructure observations, timestamps, poses/calibration files, and cooperative labels.
verifiedReferences.limitationForCandidate: The official schema's system_error_offset is a manual x/y spatial correction, not clock truth and not a decomposition of navigation pose versus extrinsic error.

verifiedReferences.title: OPV2V: An Open Benchmark Dataset and Fusion Pipeline for Perception with Vehicle-to-Vehicle Communication
verifiedReferences.factsVerified: Provides simulated collaborative data and the OpenCOOD fusion pipeline, including true and perturbed ego poses in its schema.
verifiedReferences.limitationForCandidate: Its full triplet would be constructed by simulator truth and injected delays/noise, which cannot establish natural occurrence or real-world posterior calibration.

requiredVariables: source clock offset/drift in a declared clock domain
message transport/queue latency with acquisition, send, and receive timestamps
navigation/body pose error relative to an independent pose anchor
sensor extrinsic error/drift relative to an independently surveyed or repeatedly calibrated transform
association correctness and harmful-fusion outcome labels

sampleAndFunctionChecks.observed: The schema includes camera extrinsic/intrinsic, ego_speed, lidar_pose, predicted_ego_pos, true_ego_pos, and vehicle boxes. time_delay_calculation synthesizes delay; add_loc_noise injects localization noise.
sampleAndFunctionChecks.implication: The available separation is simulator/injection truth, not a natural real-data error process.

sampleAndFunctionChecks.check: Ran jq over data/data_info_dair_paper3737.json at commit 21531399161ecb23652dbdeb80d356596e02741a.
sampleAndFunctionChecks.observed: The index has 3,737 records. The first record contains image/point-cloud paths, cooperative_label_path, and system_error_offset {delta_x: 0.66, delta_y: -1.1}; 463 unique offsets occur. No timestamp or clock-domain field is present.

sampleAndFunctionChecks.check: Read freealign/optimize.py and searched the fixed official repository snapshot for posterior/covariance implementations.
sampleAndFunctionChecks.observed: The official path performs deterministic ICP/SVD/OpenCV transform estimation. No joint posterior implementation was found in the fixed snapshot; the only covariance hit was part of deterministic optimization code.
sampleAndFunctionChecks.implication: FreeAlign is a required alignment baseline, not an available joint-posterior baseline.

groundTruthAudit.naturalOccurrencePolicy: Synthetic injection may test controlled recovery and intervention response, but its configured distribution must never be reported as a natural clock, latency, pose, or extrinsic occurrence rate.
groundTruthAudit.overallVerdict: No audited public real or semi-real dataset satisfies the item-level separable-truth contract. The central posterior and its interaction term therefore cannot be calibrated or falsified on the requested evidence base.

identifiabilityAnalysis.measurementModel: For agent i, a received sensor feature is placed in the ego/world frame through a composite transform C_i(t) = T_ego_world(t_e)^(-1) * T_body_world_i(t_i + delta_t_i) * E_sensor_to_body_i. Network observations add timestamps whose one-way difference contains source clock offset, receiver clock offset, queueing, transport, and processing delay.
identifiabilityAnalysis.firstOrderStructure: A local residual has the form r approximately J_t * delta_t + J_p * delta_xi_pose + J_e * delta_xi_extrinsic. Identifiability requires these Jacobian blocks to have independent rank over the trajectory and the clocks/geometry to be externally anchored. Ordinary detection loss or feature agreement does not guarantee that rank.

equivalenceClasses.name: body-pose/extrinsic gauge
equivalenceClasses.equivalence: For any local rigid transform H, replacing T_body_world by T_body_world * H and E_sensor_to_body by H^(-1) * E_sensor_to_body leaves their sensor-to-world composition unchanged.
equivalenceClasses.consequence: Collaborative feature alignment alone can identify at most a composite spatial registration, not navigation pose error and extrinsic error separately.

equivalenceClasses.name: time/translation confounding
equivalenceClasses.equivalence: Under approximately constant velocity, a time offset delta_t creates a longitudinal displacement v * delta_t that can be absorbed by pose translation or extrinsic translation.
equivalenceClasses.consequence: Straight constant-speed segments do not separate latency/clock offset from spatial translation.

equivalenceClasses.name: time/yaw confounding
equivalenceClasses.equivalence: Under approximately constant yaw rate, omega * delta_t can be absorbed by body heading error or extrinsic yaw.
equivalenceClasses.consequence: Turns with insufficient independent angular-rate/pose anchoring leave a time-versus-yaw equivalence class.

equivalenceClasses.name: clock/one-way-delay ambiguity
equivalenceClasses.equivalence: A one-way timestamp difference is the sum of source/receiver clock offsets and path/processing delays.
equivalenceClasses.consequence: Without a common clock or a two-way four-timestamp protocol, clock offset and one-way transport latency are not separately identifiable.

equivalenceClasses.name: static-scene temporal null space
equivalenceClasses.equivalence: In a static scene under static or near-static ego motion, multiple time shifts produce essentially the same geometry.
equivalenceClasses.consequence: Clock/latency is unobservable from feature alignment even if the spatial transform is known.

equivalenceClasses.name: object-motion/association confounding
equivalenceClasses.equivalence: A moving object's displacement can be attributed to message age, object velocity/model error, a wrong association, or agent pose error.
equivalenceClasses.consequence: End-task residuals can be multimodal and cannot label the physical cause without independent object tracks and time anchors.

equivalenceClasses.name: scene-symmetry multimodality
equivalenceClasses.equivalence: Repeated road geometry, lanes, poles, or similar objects permit multiple alignments with comparable residuals.
equivalenceClasses.consequence: A unimodal Gaussian joint posterior can be falsely sharp; a multi-hypothesis baseline is mandatory even after anchors are added.

minimumAnchorsToSeparateStates.requiredAnchor: Common PTP/GNSS-PPS/hardware trigger with logged clock domain and residual, or a calibrated two-way four-timestamp synchronization exchange.
Per-message acquisition, enqueue, transmit, receive, and decode timestamps in anchored clock domains, including dropped/reordered packets.
Independent RTK/INS, motion-capture, total-station, or equivalent reference whose uncertainty is published and not reused by the estimator under test.
Independently surveyed calibration targets or repeated target-based recalibration with thermal/mechanical state, rather than the same scene correspondences used by the tested estimator.
Trajectories with acceleration, braking, and changing yaw rate, plus static and moving-object strata, so temporal and spatial Jacobian blocks receive independent excitation.
Persistent object identities and counterfactual ego-only/fused outputs so an association error and a harmful fusion decision can be labelled without using the model's own confidence.

identifiableQuantitiesWithoutAnchors: Composite relative sensor-to-ego/world transform at an effective observation time
An aggregate age/misalignment nuisance variable under model assumptions
Task-level robustness under a declared synthetic intervention
notIdentifiableWithoutAnchors: Clock offset separately from one-way transport latency
Navigation/body pose error separately from sensor extrinsic error
Natural prior or occurrence rate of the three errors from injected perturbations
Causal probability that a specific physical error interaction caused an association or harmful-fusion failure
identifiabilityAnalysis.negativeResultNovelty: A negative result that these variables are not separable from ordinary collaborative observations is not, by itself, a new paper contribution. Gauge freedom, excitation-dependent spatiotemporal calibration, and one-way clock-delay ambiguity are established estimation facts. Novelty would require a new formal theorem for the cooperative observation model or a new public benchmark with independent anchors and failure labels; neither is currently supplied by this candidate.
identifiabilityAnalysis.verdict: The requested physical joint posterior is structurally non-identifiable on the audited public data. Treating a learned alignment latent, factor-graph state, or fusion confidence as that posterior would rename a composite nuisance variable rather than solve identification.

assets.license: UCLA Academic Software License; academic/nonprofit use with redistribution restrictions, not a standard permissive open-source license.
assets.dataAndSamples: Official docs define OPV2V annotations and link OPV2V/V2XSet/DAIR data. The inspected schema exposes true_ego_pos, predicted_ego_pos, lidar_pose, and camera extrinsics.

assets.twoWeekEntry: Feasible for fixed-fuser inference and controlled synthetic delay/location-noise interventions on a prepared subset.
assets.blockingGap: Cannot produce natural real-world triplet truth or validate posterior calibration; asynchronous and localization errors are generated by code/configuration.
assets.inspectedArtifact: opencood/data_utils/datasets/basedataset.py functions time_delay_calculation and add_loc_noise, plus the official data annotation tutorial.

assets.name: FreeAlign

assets.twoWeekEntry: Feasible as an existing deterministic joint alignment baseline if the linked checkpoint is retrieved and frozen locally.

assetAudit.requirementInterpretation: More than two official assets are commit/revision pinned and at least one official sample schema and one official delay/noise function were directly inspected. This satisfies asset verification, but it does not satisfy scientific identifiability.
assetAudit.executionBoundary: No GPU model was executed for this audit. Static code/schema checks and immutable release metadata were sufficient to establish the decisive missing-truth blocker; running inference cannot manufacture absent independent labels.

minimumStudy.reason: There is no current incrementally valid study on the requested public evidence base. A two-week run can compare fixed fusers under synthetic interventions, but cannot calibrate or validate the physical joint posterior on real/semi-real item truth.
wouldBeRequiredForReconsideration: A released real or semi-real sequence with independent clock-domain/transport timestamps, independent navigation truth, repeated independent extrinsic truth, and uncertainty for every anchor.
Natural drift/failure episodes retained separately from synthetic interventions; intervention probabilities must not be interpreted as prevalence.
At least two frozen official fusers selected from TraF-Align, CoST, CATNet, FreeAlign, CoAlign, SyncNet/CoBEVFlow/LRCP, with no new perception backbone.
A preregistered observability analysis specifying gauges, excitation strata, and which posterior coordinates are estimable.
Persistent object identities and an ego-only counterfactual sufficient to label association correctness and harmful fusion.
requiredComparisons: Three independent state estimators/posteriors with identical observations and marginal families
Deterministic timestamp compensation plus rigid warp
Existing joint alignment: FreeAlign and at least one trajectory/feature method such as TraF-Align or CoST/CATNet
Multi-hypothesis or mixture posterior that can represent scene-symmetry and association modes
Dependence-aware joint posterior with cross-state interaction removed while marginals and backbone are held fixed
Ego-only and naive-fusion counterfactuals for harmful-fusion labeling
evaluationObjects: Joint proper score on anchored state truth
Marginal proper scores and interval/region coverage by motion and scene stratum
Dependence-sensitive score comparing the joint posterior with the product of marginals and a multi-hypothesis baseline
Association correctness and harmful-fusion prediction with paired uncertainty
Detection/forecast utility only as a downstream consequence, never as proof of state identification
minimumStudy.twoWeekAssessment: Asset setup and synthetic baseline execution are feasible within two weeks, but the missing public truth and anchors are not an engineering task that can be completed by model implementation. Therefore no minimum implementation study is approved.

successCriteria.thresholdPolicy: No idea score, AP cutoff, calibration cutoff, or guessed effect-size threshold is used. Reconsideration requires identifiable variables and paired statistical evidence whose uncertainty excludes no improvement for the declared estimand.
criteria: All clock-offset, transport-latency, navigation-pose-error, and extrinsic-drift labels are independently measured rather than inferred by the evaluated model or generated solely by an injection policy.
The joint posterior is valid under multivariate proper scoring and joint region calibration on held-out real/semi-real sequences, with marginal diagnostics reported separately.
The dependence-aware posterior outperforms both the product of three independently fitted marginals and a multi-hypothesis posterior under paired held-out evaluation.

Removing only cross-state dependence while preserving observations, marginals, backbone, and compute worsens association/harm prediction and joint proper score with confidence intervals excluding no change.
The effect replicates across at least two frozen official fusers and remains after stratifying by motion excitation, static/dynamic scene content, agent geometry, and communication regime.
The posterior predicts labelled association failure and harmful fusion beyond ego-only and deterministic alignment baselines; AP alone is not accepted.
successCriteria.currentStatus: Unsatisfied because the required real/semi-real labels and validation objects are absent.

killCriteria.criterion: Any of clock/latency, navigation pose error, or extrinsic drift lacks independent item-level truth or a defensible independently anchored proxy.
killCriteria.evidence: Every audited real dataset is missing at least two components, and none supplies the complete independently labelled set.

killCriteria.criterion: The complete triplet exists only through simulator or synthetic injection.
killCriteria.evidence: OpenCOOD/OPV2V and Multi-V2X can construct the triplet, but their intervention distributions are not natural occurrence data.

killCriteria.criterion: The proposed method is only a filter/factor graph/recurrent module plus existing warp/alignment components.
killCriteria.evidence: FreeAlign, TraF-Align, CoST, CATNet, MamV2XCalib, and temporal compensation methods already occupy the component-combination space; no new identifiable estimand is available.

killCriteria.criterion: Evaluation reduces to AP or robustness under perturbation without proper posterior and association/harm labels.
killCriteria.evidence: Available benchmarks expose detection/forecast outputs but no direct physical-state and harmful-fusion validation object.

killCriteria.criterion: The joint posterior cannot beat or even be validly compared with independent, deterministic-warp, existing joint-alignment, and multi-hypothesis baselines on the same anchored truth.
killCriteria.evidence: The common anchored truth required for this comparison does not exist in the audited public assets.

killCriteria.criterion: A negative result is only the known gauge/clock-delay ambiguity without a new theorem or benchmark.
killCriteria.evidence: The current negative conclusion follows established observability structure and contributes neither a new formal result nor new anchored data.

forbiddenClaims: Do not claim the first joint temporal-spatial alignment or the first joint relative-pose/time estimator.
Do not call a unified feature representation, alignment latent, factor-graph state, or fusion confidence an identifiable clock-pose-extrinsic posterior.
Do not claim clock offset and one-way transport latency are separately estimated without anchored clock domains or a two-way timestamp protocol.
Do not claim navigation pose error and sensor extrinsic error are separately identified from their composite transform without an independent geometric anchor.
Do not report synthetic injection frequencies or configured priors as natural real-world occurrence rates.
Do not infer posterior calibration, observability, or physical-state recovery from AP, NDS, forecasting error, or feature residual alone.
Do not present filter/factor-graph plus recurrent prediction plus multi-warp fusion as the scientific novelty.
Do not claim a nonzero interaction effect unless it survives dependence-aware baselines with fixed marginals, fixed fusers, anchored truth, and paired uncertainty.
Do not call synchronized/calibrated dataset products ground truth for the residual clock, pose, or extrinsic errors unless their independent reference and uncertainty are released.
Do not describe this rejected residual as preserved or implementation-ready.

blockingFindings.finding: No audited public real/semi-real dataset jointly and independently labels clock offset/transport latency, navigation pose error, and extrinsic drift at the item/message level.
blockingFindings.decisionEffect: Triggers the user's direct reject rule.

blockingFindings.finding: The ordinary cooperative observation model identifies a composite sensor-to-world alignment only; body pose and extrinsic have a rigid-transform gauge, while time is confounded with translation/yaw under common motion regimes.
blockingFindings.decisionEffect: The target posterior is structurally non-identifiable without extra sensors/protocols.

blockingFindings.finding: One-way communication timing does not separate source/receiver clock offsets from queue, transport, and processing delay.
blockingFindings.decisionEffect: A scalar latency label or frame-index offset cannot ground the requested clock/latency coordinate.

blockingFindings.finding: No public fixed-fuser benchmark supplies direct association-failure and harmful-fusion labels tied to the three physical causes.
blockingFindings.decisionEffect: The claimed ability to predict association/harm failure has no incremental validation object.

blockingFindings.finding: The nearest work already covers joint time/pose alignment, unified spatiotemporal fusion, online registration, state-space calibration, and uncertainty-weighted delayed fusion.
blockingFindings.decisionEffect: A filter/factor-graph/module composition would not clear novelty even if it improved AP.

blockingFindings.finding: Pinned code/checkpoint assets make synthetic or nominal-calibration baselines runnable, but execution cannot repair missing real labels.
blockingFindings.decisionEffect: GPU feasibility does not change the reject decision.

blockingFindings.finding: The remaining negative result is an instance of known gauge and observability limits unless accompanied by a new theorem or independently anchored public benchmark.
blockingFindings.decisionEffect: A negative-only paper is not presently novel.
